connect.title: Connect
connect.intro: Find your library on the LAN, or type its address.
connect.none: No servers answered. Enter the address instead.
connect.offline: Library unreachable. Retrying in the background.

pair.title: Pair
pair.intro: Open Devices in the web UI and enter the 6-digit code.

library.nothing: This title has no installable content.

detail.warn_battery: Warning: the battery is below 15% and not charging.
detail.clear_firmware: Needs firmware {}, newer than this console. The requirement will be cleared so HOME launches it; a game built for newer firmware may still not start.
detail.warn_firmware_version: Warning: this console is older than the required firmware {}

updates.intro: Updates in the library that look newer than what is installed.
updates.empty: Installed games have no newer updates in the library.

missing.intro: Base games in the library that are not on this Switch. Open one to install.
missing.empty: Every base game in the library is already installed.

installed.empty: Nothing is installed on this Switch.
installed.reset_body: Clears the firmware version the game and its update say they need (“A system update is required”) and the update version HOME expects (for example after an update was removed). A game built for newer firmware than this console may still fail to start.
installed.reset_done: Required version reset. Try launching the game again, and restart the console if HOME still asks.
installed.reset_failed: Could not reset the required version ({})

queue.empty: No jobs yet. Send a title from the web UI, or install from Library.

settings.name: This Switch
settings.forget_confirm: Forget this server and pair again next time?
settings.update_none: You're already on the latest signed release.
settings.update_available: A newer signed build is on GitHub. Download and replace this app?
settings.update_available_server: A newer signed build is on your library server. Download and replace this app?
settings.update_done: Updated. Restart NSLibrary from the Homebrew Menu.
settings.update_check_server: Checking the library server for updates

saves.intro: Back up saves to the library, or restore one. Y reloads.
saves.unsupported: This library server can't store saves. Update it to use this tab.
saves.empty: No game saves on this console yet.
saves.loading: Reading the saves on this console
saves.none_on_server: No backups of this game on the library yet.
saves.unchanged: Already backed up; nothing had changed
saves.backup_failed: Could not back up the save
saves.all_failed: Some saves could not be backed up
saves.all_summary: {} backed up, {} already up to date
saves.restore_body: Restore the backup from {} into {}'s save? The save on this console is backed up to the library first, so this can be undone.
saves.busy: Wait for the install to finish first.

errors.open_save: Could not open the save ({}). If the game is running, close it from HOME and try again.
errors.list_saves: Could not list the saves on this console
errors.list: Could not list {} in the save
errors.open: Could not open {} in the save
errors.read: Could not read {} in the save
errors.create: Could not create {} in the save
errors.write: Could not write {} in the save
errors.sd_read: Could not read {} on the SD card
errors.sd_write: Could not write to the SD card ({})
errors.sd_full: The SD card is full or read-only
errors.changed: The save changed while it was backed up ({}). Close the game and try again.
errors.unsupported: This save cannot be backed up: {}
errors.not_archive: This backup is not a usable save archive: {}
errors.other_type: That backup is of a different save, so it cannot be restored into this one.
errors.damaged: The backup arrived damaged (its SHA-256 does not match). Try again.
errors.too_big: This backup does not fit in the game's save on this console.
errors.incomplete: Part of the backup was already written, so the save is incomplete. Restore the backup marked “Before a restore” to put it back.
